reviews.title: Your Reviews
reviews.subtitle: What our customers say about us.

r1.name: Simous B.
r1.text: We stumbled upon this place by chance and really had a great time. A friendly spot where even the kids could have a good time surrounded by adults. Service with a smile, and the iced tea was really good too.

r2.name: Lalie M.
r2.text: I loved spending time having a drink with my family. A Nutella waffle at 4 PM and I never left. The evening happy hour with a €4 pint is exceptional. I highly recommend this place.

r3.name: Lucas R.
r3.text: I had a great time at L’Arche bar! Thanks to the €4 happy hour, we were able to enjoy some great cocktails at a very affordable price. The staff is super friendly, and the atmosphere is by far the best of all the bars in Clermont. I definitely recommend it!

storyPage.title: Our Story
storyPage.subtitle: An urban third-place in the heart of Clermont-Ferrand.
storyPage.p1: "When I have an idea in my head, I go for it." With this conviction, Noé De La Rochette chose to take over the former Waffle Café at 14 Rue Saint-Genès, officially opening L'Arche in May 2026.
storyPage.p2: Conceived as a true urban third-place, the space breaks away from traditional codes. Neither a simple cafe nor an ordinary bar, it is a hybrid meeting point that evolves throughout the day: from morning coffee and croissants to quick lunches, and evening drinks shared with friends.
storyPage.p3: The former tea-room concept gives way to a versatile bar with a broader scope, designed to welcome local residents, students, and professionals alike.
storyPage.p4: Anchored in one of the city's most vibrant streets, L'Arche brings a warm, complementary vibe designed to breathe new life into this landmark location on Rue Saint-Genès.
storyPage.quote: "The neighborhood is very beautiful, it represents the city well I think."
